newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Swedish Nov unemployment seen 7.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swedish Nov unemployment seen 7.4 pct.

text.p: Unemployment in November is forecast on average to drop to 7.4 percent from October's 7.6 percent and compared with 7.2 percent in November last year, according to a survey by Reuters of 16 analysts.
The forecasts ranged between 7.2 and 7.7 percent.
For the whole year the figure is seen rising on average to 7.9 percent. The forecasts ranged from 7.7 to 8.1 percent.
Statistics Sweden announces the November unemployment data at 1200 GMT on December 6.

Sources: Carnegie, Chase, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, JP Morgan, Lehman Brothers (only monthly data), Nordbanken, PaineWebber, Salomon Brothers, S-E-Banken, Union Bank of Switzerland, Unibank Markets.
